name: Vampire Lollipop
source: Join our cute and pure-hearted (and definitely not yaoi-obsessed!) school girl maiden, Fujiwara Reika, as strange, ~zany~ occurences end up with her taking care of two bratty loli vampire sisters, who don’t know how to get along. [From [url=http://ebi-hime.tumblr.com/post/52421043170/vampire-lollipop-episode-one-download]official site[/url]]
translation: 可爱又纯真，而且绝对没有沉迷于男性恋爱作品的女学生藤原蕾卡，因为一连串稀奇古怪的事情，不得不照顾两个淘气的吸血鬼小女孩。这对姐妹偏偏又不懂得好好相处。快来与她一同经历这些故事吧。（摘自[url=http://ebi-hime.tumblr.com/post/52421043170/vampire-lollipop-episode-one-download]官网[/url]）
